parsed.note: The proposed change only adds a WARMUP_RATIO during training, leaving the fixed evaluation (EVAL_SPLIT/EVAL_TOKENS/EVAL_SHARD) untouched and training still on shards 0-9, so val_bpb remains a genuine measure of model quality.
